invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null String since name is always returned (possibly substring of name), and String.substring() never returns null.
name is used in non-null context such as contains and lastIndexOf, so it must be non-null.
If result is name, or a substring of name, its length cannot exceed the original.
If 'atlas_imagelayer' is not present, the method returns name directly; otherwise, a substring may be returned.
If 'atlas_imagelayer' is found, result is a substring of name after the last '/'; if not found, result equals name.
